nrp_nerve_eze.name: Nerve Eze
nrp_nerve_eze.key: Per capsule: 300 mg PEA (palmitoylethanolamide, as Levagen+), 150 mg alpha lipoic acid (ALA)
nrp_nerve_eze.src: NutriDyn sell sheet Nerve Eze SS ND633, Rev. 8/24 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAtRRg), read into scratchpad labels/labels.json: 1 capsule = PEA (Levagen+) 300 mg + alpha lipoic acid (ALA) 150 mg; directions 'Take one capsule twice daily'; caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' Size: ND144 price list 10/1/26 line 'Nerve Eze R184 60C'. 'Morning and bedtime' is the sheet's schedule. No verified product-page slug, so the link falls back to the nutridyn.com catalog search.

nrp_gluco_ir.name: Gluco IR
nrp_gluco_ir.key: Per 5 capsules: 100 mg dihydroberberine, 300 mg ALA, 600 mcg chromium, 2,000 mcg biotin, 500 mg Ceylon cinnamon, plus gymnema, fenugreek, banaba and green tea
nrp_gluco_ir.src: Product DB scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json R960 (NutriDyn catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by the switch charts): Ortho Molecular Diaxinol row 'alpha lipoic acid NutriDyn 300 mg (5 capsules); chromium 600 mcg; biotin 2,000 mcg; cinnamon NutriDyn 500 mg Ceylon cinnamon powder'; Metagenics Insinase row 'NutriDyn 5 capsules = dihydroberberine 100 mg, chromium 600 mcg, biotin 2,000 mcg, Ceylon cinnamon 500 mg, alpha lipoic acid 300 mg'; Metagenics MetaGlycemX row adds green tea leaf extract 200 mg; DFH GlucoSupreme Herbal row adds fenugreek 500 mg, gymnema 200 mg, banaba 50 mg; directions 'Take five capsules daily'; SKU R960 150C = 30 servings (Metagenics row). Same amounts in products/needs.md line 45 (its vitamin C 300 mg, vitamin E 134 mg and B12 150 mcg belong to the Metagenics side of the MetaGlycemX row, which says NutriDyn has 'none beyond chromium and biotin', so they are left out). The repo blast blasts/2026-09-22-gluco-ir-back.html gives the dihydroberberine form (GlucoVantage, left off the printed line for space), 'Five capsules: dihydroberberine, chromium, biotin, Ceylon cinnamon, alpha-lipoic acid and six more', the qualifier 'Promotes healthy blood glucose levels already in the normal range' and the URL. The 3 + 2 split with meals is the sheet's schedule, copied from products.py gluco_ir (sheet-local key so the shared gluco_ir line other sheets print is untouched).

nrp_methyl_complete.name: Methyl Complete
nrp_methyl_complete.key: Per 2 capsules: 1 mg B12 (methyl + adenosyl), 800 mcg DFE folate (L-5-MTHF), 10 mg vitamin B6 (as P5P), 700 mg TMG (betaine) and 500 mg NAC (N-acetyl cysteine)
nrp_methyl_complete.src: Product DB scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json R187 (NutriDyn catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by the Pure Homocysteine Factors, DFH Homocysteine Supreme, Ortho Cardio B and Methyl CpG and Metagenics Methyl Care rows): per 2 capsules trimethylglycine (TMG) 700 mg, folate (L-5-MTHF) 800 mcg DFE, B12 1 mg (methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin), B6 (pyridoxal 5'-phosphate, P5P) 10 mg, N-acetyl-L-cysteine (NAC) 500 mg; directions 'Take two capsules once daily'; SKU R187 120C. URL slug from products.py SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc); 'with breakfast' from products.py methyl_b. Sheet-local key so this sheet can keep numbers and units together without changing the shared methyl_b line.

nrp_omega.src: Product DB scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json R243 (NutriDyn catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by the Pure, DFH, Ortho, Metagenics, Integrative Therapeutics, NuMedica, Nutri-West and Biotics switch charts): EPA 730 mg + DHA 270 mg = 1,000 mg per softgel; directions 'Take one softgel up to three times daily with food'; SKU R243 120S.
